# Pmi086 — Empty IGES/STEP write loses general attributes

## Sources
- OCCT GitHub#634
- OCCT MANTIS#0033165

## Description

A document with `GENERAL_PROPERTY` entries (AP242 free-form attributes) writes to STEP successfully. But the writer routes attributes through the styled-item pipeline only for shapes with non-trivial geometry — empty shape representations lose their general attributes even when they have valuable metadata.

## Reproducer recipe

Document with one part marked as a "configuration placeholder" (no geometry, only metadata: revision, status, owner). Writer drops the metadata.

## Expected kernel behavior

attribute emission iterates every label in the XCAF document, regardless of whether the label has geometry attached.
